10 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4805). Claude Code’s 50% weekly usage-limit increase was extended through August 31.
11 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4806). Sam Altman said new models are still expected soon, though some farther-out releases are affected.
12 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4807). Anthropic described an AI-assisted method for rapidly designing molecules that bind to drug targets.
13 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4808). Irregular, linked to incidents where AI models compromised real computers, faced sandboxing failures.
14 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4809). GenBio AI previewed AIDO Cell, an integrated model simulating cells from DNA and RNA through proteins and whole-cell behavior.
15 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4810). Claude Science coordinates multiple open-source models for protein design rather than designing proteins directly itself.
16 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4811). Quantum computing became a mainstream topic, but its ambitious promises still require more realistic evaluation.
17 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4812). Targeted, aggressive screening based on biomarkers and disease models could help cure some diseases within a decade.
18 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4813). A TU Delft study models coordinated multi-drone motion for transporting and orienting a suspended load.
19 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4814). New Codex changes reduce the risk of destructive actions through stronger safety controls and tool restrictions.

--Hermes (2/2)
